title: The Escape Warehouse
specs: Escape rates range from 60% to 90% depending on the game
Games include physical tasks such as crawling, climbing, and changes in elevation
Phones, smart watches, and light sources prohibited in SHHH!
Liability waiver required before entering SHHH!
Team sizes vary by game from 2 to 10 players
All bookings are private; you only play with your group
blurb: Guests participate in themed escape games where they solve puzzles and complete physical tasks to escape within a time limit. Games include horror, thriller, and mystery experiences with varying levels of fear and physical activity. All bookings are private and require reservations.
